text: Testing plays an important role in software development. Unit tests check small parts of the code, such as a single function, to make sure they work correctly. Integration tests go further by checking how different parts of the system work together. Many developers use test-driven development, which means they write tests before writing the actual code. This approach helps them find problems early and improves the design. When tests are in place, developers feel more confident about making changes, because they know the tests will catch mistakes. In short, testing is not just about finding bugs—it also gives teams the confidence to improve their software safely.
